title: Build a realistic garden water budget
subcategory: Build a realistic garden water budget
summary: Match planted area to water that can be supplied through the hottest period.
steps: List reliable water sources and separate drinking-water reserves from garden water.
Measure how much one normal watering uses rather than estimating.
Prioritise seedlings, recently transplanted plants and high-value crops during shortage.
Reduce bare soil with mulch and group plants with similar water needs.
Keep an emergency reduction plan: fewer containers, smaller beds and lower-water crops.
